title: Distance Formula — Coordinate Geometry
hook: Let's explore Distance Formula from the chapter on Coordinate Geometry. This is an important concept in NCERT Class 10 Mathematics that builds your foundation for higher studies!
explanation:
Distance Formula The distance between two points (x₁,y₁) and (x₂,y₂) is √[(x₂−x₁)² + (y₂−y₁)²]. Derived from Pythagoras theorem applied to the coordinate plane. Key Ideas to Master:
💡 Distance = √[(x₂−x₁)² + (y₂−y₁)²]
💡 Distance from origin: √(x² + y²)
💡 If distance = 0, the points are the same
💡 Used to check collinearity: three points are collinear if AB + BC = AC
